quote: Some Problems of 'Partitio Numerorum.' III. On the Expression of a Number as a Sum of Primes (Hardy-Littlewood, Acta Mathematica, 1923)
posed_by: G. H. Hardy and J. E. Littlewood
note: The conjecture about infinitely many prime quadruplets was posed as a special case of the Hardy-Littlewood k-tuple conjecture in their 1923 paper in Acta Mathematica, vol. 44, pp. 1–70. While related work on prime constellations predates this (Polignac 1849, Dickson 1904), the specific conjecture about prime quadruplets appears to originate from Hardy-Littlewood 1923.
